title: Recognition of Cutaneous Melanoma on Digitized Histopathological Slides via Artificial Intelligence Algorithm.
summary: The article reports 96.5% training classification accuracy, sensitivity 95.7%, specificity 97.7% and κ 0.929; it notes larger datasets are needed. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: An Inception-ResNet-v2 CNN classified melanoma and healthy tissue patches from digitized histopathology slides.

evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
